Article 6 (Matters to Be Stated in Reports on Case Handling)
When submitting written reports and notifications under Article 12 of the Act, the special prosecutor shall specifically state the substance and grounds of the decision to institute or not institute a public prosecution, or of a final and conclusive judgment, and details of the progress and activities of the investigation and trial.
